accessibility.title: ♿ Accessibility Guidelines
accessibility.description: Ensure your alerts are accessible to all users with proper ARIA attributes, focus management, and screen reader compatibility.
bestPractices: Use appropriate ARIA roles (alert, alertdialog, status)
Include descriptive text, not just colors or icons
Provide keyboard navigation for interactive elements
avoid: Using only colors to convey importance
Overwhelming users with too many alerts
Making alert text too small to read
Hiding important actions behind unnecessary clicks
